titre: Complémentaire santé solidaire (C2S): free or low-cost top-up health cover
resume: Free or low-cost top-up health cover for the whole household, children included, based on your income over the last 12 months, with higher limits in French Guiana.
aQuoiCaSert: The Complémentaire santé solidaire (C2S) covers the share of health expenses not reimbursed by the Assurance Maladie (French public health insurance), up to the Sécurité sociale (social security) rates. It is free or comes with a small monthly contribution depending on your resources, and covers everyone in the household, so your children too. It is often the solution when you have no mutuelle (top-up health insurance) and a low income.
quiEstConcerne: Low-income households who have lived in France on a stable and lawful basis for more than 3 months.
People receiving the RSA (revenu de solidarité active, the minimum income benefit): free C2S is granted automatically, unless they object.
Single parents and families who have no top-up health cover for their children.
aSavoir: With the C2S: no extra fees above the standard rates (dépassements d'honoraires), third-party payment (no upfront payment), daily hospital charge (forfait hospitalier) covered.
Annual limits in French Guiana for free C2S: €11,599 for 1 person, €17,398 for 2, €20,878 for 3, €24,358 for 4, plus €4,640 per additional person.
C2S with a contribution in French Guiana: resources up to €15,659 for 1 person, €23,488 for 2, €28,185 for 3, €32,883 for 4, plus €6,263 per additional person.

The resources counted are those of the 12 months before the application. A flat-rate housing amount (forfait logement) is added if you receive housing benefit, are housed free of charge or own your home.
Decision within 2 months. Without a reply within this time, the application is accepted. If refused, an amicable appeal is possible within 2 months.

The C2S is granted for 1 year. Renewal must be requested between 4 and 2 months before the end date, unless it is automatic (RSA, Aspa and Asi minimum benefits, and the AAH (adult disability allowance) with no change of situation).
Separated parents: the C2S is granted to the household that applies. A child in shared residence is in principle part of only one parent's household: ask your health insurance fund.

documents.libelle: Cerfa n° 12504 form, completed and signed, if you are not applying online
documents.detail: It includes the list of household members and their resources over the last 12 months.

documents.libelle: Tax notice (avis d'impôt) or tax return statement (Asdir)
Property tax notice (taxe foncière), if you own your home
Housing tax notice (taxe d'habitation), if applicable
Proof of resources for the last 12 months, if requested
documents.detail: Payslips, allowances, child support received. The fund may ask for additional information.

documents.libelle: Statement of resources from the Caf or the MSA, if an RSA application is under way
documents.detail: Download it from your Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office) account.

documents.libelle: Tax and social security documents from each country, if you lived abroad in the last 12 months

documents.detail: It shows the end date of your entitlement: note it for the renewal.

etapes.detail: Add up the household's resources over 12 months and compare them with the French Guiana limits. Have your tax notice and income statements ready.
From your ameli account: this is the fastest way. You can also send the Cerfa n° 12504 form to your health insurance fund.

If you submit the file at the front desk: signed form, tax notice, property or housing tax notice, Caf certificate if an RSA application is under way, proof of resources, ID document and carte Vitale (health insurance card). Make photocopies.
It is made within 2 months. If refused, refer the matter to the amicable appeals board (commission de recours amiable) within 2 months.
Between 4 and 2 months before the end date shown on your certificate.

ou.nom: Caisse générale de sécurité sociale (CGSS) de la Guyane, the local social security fund
ou.detail: Apply online on ameli or at the front desk. Phone 36 46.
Help with online procedures near you.

datesLimites.detail: To the fund's amicable appeals board.
